name: talk-field
prompt: Use the man from the reference image (same face, short dark curly hair, thin round tortoiseshell glasses, light stubble) wearing a cream chunky knit sweater with a small black lavalier microphone clipped to the collar. Ultra-wide shot: he sits on a folding wooden stool in a grassy clifftop meadow above the Pacific Ocean, small in the frame, facing the camera from about eight metres away and mid-sentence with a small hand gesture; a silver laptop rests closed on a second stool beside him. Tall grass moves in the wind, the ocean and a hazy coastline stretch behind him. Look: cinematic still shot on an ARRI Alexa with a wide 24mm lens at golden hour, graded like Fujifilm Classic Negative with fine film grain, soft warm backlight, gentle haze. Real, candid, documentary interview feel. No retouching, no CGI look, no text, no logos.
